name: Repoevo – Plugin Analytics, Keyword Tracking & Competitor Monitoring
author: achimschmid

sections.description:
Repoevo is the analytics and monitoring dashboard built specifically for WordPress plugin developers, agencies and indie makers who want to grow their plugins on WordPress.org.

Stop guessing. Start growing.

📊 Plugin Analytics & Statistics

Everything you need to understand your plugin’s performance:

  • Active installs & total downloads
  • Daily download trends with visual charts
  • Ratings, reviews and conversion rate tracking
  • Version-based performance analysis
  • Growth spikes and drop detection

🏆 Keyword Tracking & SEO for WordPress.org

Rank higher on WordPress.org search:

  • Track your WordPress.org tag rankings over time
  • Add custom keywords and monitor your position
  • Automatically discover keywords your plugin already ranks for
  • Identify untapped ranking opportunities
  • Full ranking history with trend visualization

📈 Growth & Version Tracking

Understand how every update impacts your plugin:

  • Compare performance across versions
  • Detect the exact impact of updates and changelogs
  • Measure growth trends week by week and month by month

🤝 Competitor Analysis & Benchmarking

Know your competition — beat your competition:

  • See which plugins compete for the same keywords
  • Compare rankings, installs and conversion rates side by side
  • Monitor competitor growth over time
  • Add competitor plugins to your dashboard with one click

📄 PDF Export

  • Export your plugin analytics as a clean PDF report
  • Includes download chart, keyword ranking chart and stats
  • Perfect for client reporting — available in Pro and Business

⚡ Smart, Fast & Lightweight

  • Automatic data collection — zero manual work
  • Intelligent cache system for instant load times
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized
  • Clean and modern WordPress admin dashboard

Who is Repoevo for?

  • Plugin developers — understand your growth and dominate WordPress.org search rankings
  • WordPress agencies — monitor client plugins and deliver clear PDF performance reports
  • Indie makers — discover untapped keyword opportunities and grow faster
  • Competitor researchers — benchmark any plugin on WordPress.org

Features

  • Monitor any WordPress.org plugin
  • Track active installs, downloads and ratings
  • Conversion rate tracking (installs vs. downloads)
  • Version-based performance analysis
  • WordPress.org tag and keyword ranking tracking
  • Custom keyword monitoring
  • Automatic keyword discovery
  • Competitor plugin comparison and benchmarking
  • Visual download and keyword ranking charts
  • PDF export for analytics reports
  • Clean, modern and lightweight interface

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve monitoring and analytics data.

Service provider: Webagentur BGL
Service URL: https://api.webagentur-bgl.com
Privacy Policy: https://repoevo.com/datenschutzerklaerung/
Terms of Service: https://repoevo.com/agb/

Data sent:
* Plugin slugs of monitored items
* Analysis timestamps (last known analysis time per item)
* Site URL (only when connecting an API key)

Data usage:
The transmitted data is used exclusively to provide analytics, monitoring and update detection features. No personal user data is collected or transmitted. The external API is required for the core functionality of this plugin.

Chart.js is loaded locally and used to render analytics charts within the plugin dashboard. No data is sent to Chart.js or any CDN.

Source Code

This plugin includes minified JavaScript files compiled from source files located in assets/js/admin/ within the plugin directory. The unminified source files are included in the plugin package.

Third-party libraries included locally:
* Chart.js (https://www.chartjs.org/) — MIT License
* chartjs-plugin-annotation (https://www.chartjs.org/chartjs-plugin-annotation/) — MIT License
* html2canvas (https://html2canvas.hertzen.com/) — MIT License
* jsPDF (https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) — MIT License

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open Repoevo in your WordPress admin
  4. Connect your free API key
  5. Add any plugin slug and start monitoring immediately
sections.faq:
What can I monitor?

Any plugin from the official WordPress.org repository — your own plugins or any competitor.

Does this track keyword rankings?

Yes. WordPress.org tags and custom keywords are tracked over time with full ranking history and trend visualization.

Does this show keywords I am not tracking yet?

Yes. Repoevo automatically detects keywords your plugin already ranks for and suggests them — even if you never added them manually. Pro users see the exact ranking positions.

Can I export my analytics as PDF?

Yes. Pro and Business users can export a full analytics report as PDF directly from the dashboard — including download charts, keyword rankings and stats.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. Core analytics including download tracking, install tracking and keyword ranking is fully free. Pro and Business plans unlock custom keyword tracking, PDF export and more plugins.

Where can I find the documentation?

Full documentation is available at https://repoevo.com/docs/

Does this work for any WordPress.org plugin?

Yes — you can monitor any public plugin on WordPress.org, not just your own.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: PDF Export — export full analytics report as PDF (Pro & Business)
  • New: Upgrade page — redesigned plan comparison with full feature overview
  • Fix: Chart height no longer overflows into next section on wider viewports

1.1.4

  • Fix: Keyword ranking legend now correctly displays “>100” when plugin is not ranked in Top 100
  • Fix: Download trend line no longer extends into negative values

1.1.3

  • Fix: Plan changes (upgrade/downgrade) now instantly reflected in detail view
  • Fix: Range filter (3 months, 6 months) no longer triggers security error
  • Fix: Plan always loaded fresh from API — cache no longer serves stale plan data

1.1.2

  • Security: Nonce verification added for detail view
  • Security: All echoed variables properly escaped
  • Code: Unique repoevo_ prefix applied throughout
  • Fix: Plan changes now correctly reflected in detail view

1.1.1

  • Fix: Plugins with status “not monitored” (plan limit) can now be reconnected directly from the dashboard with one click

1.1.0

  • New: Discovered Keywords — automatically detects keywords your plugin ranks for
  • New: Collapsible sections for Discovered Keywords and Plugin Comparison
  • New: Pro feature — unlock exact ranking positions for discovered keywords
  • Improvement: Cache system optimized with ranking-based expiry times

1.0.1

  • Security: Nonce verification enforced for keyword actions
  • Fix: Nonce passed correctly via JavaScript form submission

1.0.0

  • Initial release
